method.label: How to sign in
method.description: Most Overcast accounts have no email address or password, so scanning the code with the Overcast app is usually the only way in.

manifest.description: Import your podcast subscriptions and playback progress from Overcast.

user.title: Connect Overcast
user.description: Choose how to sign in to your Overcast account.

scan_qr.title: Scan to connect
scan_qr.description: Point your iPhone camera at the code and open the link to approve it in the Overcast app. On the phone itself, tap the code instead. A fresh code appears automatically if this one is left too long.
scan_qr.progress_text: Waiting for you to approve this in the Overcast app...

credentials.title: Sign in to Overcast
credentials.description: Only works for accounts that have an email address and password set.

abort.login_timeout: The code was not approved in time.
abort.no_login_token: Overcast did not offer a code to scan.
abort.no_session_cookie: Overcast approved the login but did not start a session.

errors.credentials_required: Enter both an email address and a password.
